name: implement-browser-io
description: Bucket B of docs/audit/impossible.md: rework File-menu affordances to browser-native forms (bypass cmd.tenmol_files; call the engine directly and download). Tasks added/verified one at a time so each postcondition matches the code actually written.

tasks.title: Shared browser blob-download helper (download.ts) + test
tasks.instructions: New apps/web/src/features/files/download.ts exporting downloadBlob/downloadBytes/downloadText (createObjectURL -> <a download> -> click -> revoke). Verified by download.dom.test.ts.

tasks.title: File > Open... becomes a browser file picker that loads file CONTENTS via the engine (no cmd.tenmol_files.*)
tasks.instructions: Rewrite FilesPanel.fileOpen and FileDropTarget.uploadAndLoad to open a real <input type=file>, read await file.text(), and load the contents through session.act cmd.load(content, name, 0, '') (blank format => engine sniffs). Preserve the engine-independent .pwg/refusal guard (globalDrop.refusalFor + new browserClassification). No ensure()/pick/api.upload/plan_open. The traj/map/mtz/mae/.pse modal + presentation pipeline (runStep/loadPlain/enterPresentation) is untouched and still reached via Open Recent / deep link (requestFilesOpen -> openPaths).

tasks.title: File > Save Session / Save Session As... (and the Ctrl+S twin) serialize cmd.get_session and download it (no cmd.tenmol_files.*, no `save <path>`)
tasks.instructions: Rewrite FilesPanel.sessionSaveAs and both the session-save/session-save-as menu items, plus the Ctrl+S branch in FileDropTarget, to obtain the snapshot with `await session.call('cmd.get_session')` and save it via `downloadText(name, JSON.stringify(snap), 'application/octet-stream')`. Filename comes from window.prompt defaulting to .pse (the engine reload path keys off .pse/.psw). Drop ensure/setInitialdir/recentAdd/PathPicker/api.sessionFile and never `save <path>` (writes to disk + THROWS in the browser). Works over the remote bridge too, so unconditional.

tasks.title: File > Export Molecule... seeds the dialog from cmd.get_names and downloads cmd.get_str output (single-file only; multi-file OUT OF SCOPE)
tasks.instructions: Keep the ExportMoleculeDialog UI but seed its SaveMoleculeInfo from `session.call('cmd.get_names', ['objects'|'public_selections'])` + static setting defaults (no bridge save_molecule_info). On save keep the five pre-save `set` writes as session.run('set …'), pick the format from the chosen filter/extension (pdb/cif/mol/sdf/mol2/xyz/fasta), `const text = await session.call('cmd.get_str', [format, selection, state])`, then `downloadText(`${name}.${ext}`, text)` with a window.prompt name. Drop saveCheck/recentAdd/PathPicker/api.saveMoleculeInfo/api.multiFileNames. Multi-file (multisave/multifilesave) and Export Map/Alignment stay OUT OF SCOPE (bridge-bound or gracefully refused).
